result.note: A brief infrastructure item. The question tests the scope and one feature of the NHAI's uniform design standards.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) issued uniform design standards for highways. Consider the following statements about these standards:
items: They apply to new four- and six-lane access-controlled highways.
They include barriers to keep out stray cattle.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. On 23 September 2026 the NHAI issued uniform design standards covering new four- and six-lane access-controlled highways. The standards include barriers to keep stray cattle off these roads.
questions.source: The NHAI issued uniform design standards for new four- and six-lane access-controlled highways, including barriers to keep out stray cattle.
